title: acanthocalyx nepalensis subsp. delavayi
intro: Acanthocalyx nepalensis subsp. delavayi, commonly known as Himalayan bugloss, is a plant species within the Boraginaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Himalayan bugloss include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
